confidence_notes: Low confidence: Cuba has multiple exchange rates and sparse, conflicting price data. Food and drink anchors triangulate web-search summaries of crowdsourced cost-of-living sites (Numbeo, HikersBay, Gotripzi, MyLifeElsewhere) and travel-guide ranges (inexpensive meal ~$3.7-9, dinner for two ~$20-28, beer ~$1.6-2.5, cappuccino ~$1.1-2.1), nudged toward tourist-facing USD pricing. No direct glass-of-wine price was found; wine (~2x beer) and cocktail (~2.4x beer, cross-checked with 2026 bar-guide mojito ranges of ~$5-10) are relationship-based. Accommodation is a holistic estimate from general knowledge (casa-particular-dominated market, few formal hostels), not from searches or live listings. FX is the RBA USD-per-AUD rate for 2026-11-18 as reported in a search result for the RBA exchange-rates page.
comparable_city_reasoning: No close comparable city; Havana-specific aggregator prices adjusted toward tourist-facing USD pricing, with lodging reasoned from Cuba's casa-particular-dominated market and Caribbean/Latin American budget-tourism norms.
